title: Quisiera o querría: alternancias de la apódosis en prosa formal
goal: Deploy stylistic variations in the conditional apodosis (substituting conditional simple with -ra forms in modal verbs) in high register literature and journalism.
grammar: Alternancia estilística en la apódosis condicional

sections.title: Unit 9: Conditionals I — Lesson 2
body: Welcome to lesson 2 of Unit 9 (Conditionals I: Potential Scenarios). Mastering hypothetical conditionals enables you to explore alternatives, negotiate terms, and calibrate diplomatic courtesy.
In this lesson, we study quisiera o querría: alternancias de la apódosis en prosa formal, establishing rigorous command of imperfect subjunctive and conditional correlatives.

items: Deploy stylistic variations in the conditional apodosis (substituting conditional simple with -ra forms in modal verbs) in high register literature and journalism.
Incorporate advanced negotiation vocabulary (la elocuencia, solemne).
